metadata.note: 28/53 stores are precisely located; 21 more are geocoded only to a town centroid (distances suppressed, not fabricated) and 4 have no coordinates at all.

overlap_risk_method: overlap_risk = 0.6×clamp(1 − nearest_own_km/5, 0, 1) + 0.4×clamp(own_within["3km"]/4, 0, 1). Geography-only heuristic (no sales data exists to calibrate against) — a relative screening signal, not a measurement. kind: "derived". null when either input is unavailable — NEVER computed from a town-centroid coordinate.
